SELECT f.userregistry, f.tierstep, e.engrate, 
       COALESCE(AVG(i.giftvalusd), 0) as avg_gift_val,
       COALESCE(SUM(i.gifttot), 0) as total_gifts,
       COALESCE(SUM(i.giftvalusd), 0) as total_gift_val

SELECT f.userregistry, e.engrate, e.socintscore, e.actdayswk, e.avgsesscount,
       (e.engrate * 0.4) + ((e.socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3) + ((e.actdayswk::numeric / 7.0) * 0.2) + ((e.avgsesscount::numeric / 10.0) * 0.1) as fei

JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
